sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']
greens = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'N']
print(f"Green blocks: {len(greens)}")

# Check positions
for g in greens:
    rows = [pt[0] for pt in g['boundary']]
    cols = [pt[1] for pt in g['boundary']]
    cr, cc = sum(rows)//len(rows), sum(cols)//len(cols)
    print(f"  ({cr}, {cc})")

# Sort by row then col (descending)
greens.sort(key=lambda g: (min(pt[0] for pt in g['boundary']), min(pt[1] for pt in g['boundary'])), reverse=True)

# Click all remaining green blocks from right to left (bottom first)
for g in greens:
    rows = [pt[0] for pt in g['boundary']]
    cols = [pt[1] for pt in g['boundary']]
    cr, cc = sum(rows)//len(rows), sum(cols)//len(cols)
    print(f"Clicking ({cr}, {cc})...")
    action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': cr, 'col': cc}])
    
    greens_after = [n for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
    print(f"  -> {len(greens_after)} greens, game_over={last_action_result.get('game_over')}")
    
    if last_action_result.get('game_over'):
        print("  GAME OVER!")
        break
    if last_action_result.get('level_completed'):
        print("  LEVEL COMPLETED!")
        break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
